fields.name: Gloucester Badminton Club
fields.blurb: Welcome to the page for Gloucester Badminton Club! We are a friendly club usually on the lookout for new players. Please see our website (linked below) for further details about the club.

fields.name: Allseasons Badminton Club
fields.blurb:
Come along and give us a try!

The Allseasons Badminton Club is a Cheltenham based club which is always looking for new competitive people to join us.

We are a friendly bunch of people, so if you are looking to get back into playing competitively, you will be most welcome.

So if you are interested please Contact Us or come along for a trial. 

Club night is Tuesday evenings between 8pm - 10pm, from the 1st Tuesday of September through to the end of April, at Pates Grammar School, Cheltenham.
Fees
September to December inclusive - £60.00
January to April inclusive - £60.00
Guests - £5.00 per night

Special Offer
September to April inclusive - £115.00
If paid within the first two weeks of September

fields.name: Brockworth Nomads Badminton Club
fields.blurb:
Brockworth Nomads is a friendly club with capacity to accept new
members.  We run two mixed teams, one mens and one ladies, but we'd like
to have more teams.  Our club night is Tuesday, 7pm to 9pm, at Henley
Bank Sports Centre, Brockworth, which is between Gloucester and
Cheltenham.  This is also our match night and venue.  Fees for the
2025-2026 season (September to early in April) are £125, but new members
joining part way through the season will be offered a reduced rate. 
Come along and give us a try, we charge visitors £5 for each visit, but
this will be deducted from the fees if you decide to join us.  Our ethos
is to enjoy the game while playing the best that we can in matches, so
if this sounds like your sort of club then contact us via the Club Email
or search for Brockworth Nomads on Facebook.

fields.name: Hatherley Badminton Club
fields.blurb:
We play every Thursday from 7:00–9:00pm at Halo Brockworth Sports Centre.
For the 2025/26 season (September–May), membership fees are £140. An additional £21.50 Badminton England affiliation fee may apply if required. New players are welcome to attend a trial period of up to 3 sessions at £6 per session, subject to availability and playing standard. Please contact in advance if you would like to come for a trial. 

                                                       

                                              


During the summer months (June–August), we run a summer club open to suitable players at £6 per session or £40 for the full period.

fields.name: Malvern Hills Badminton Club
fields.blurb: We are a friendly, competitive badminton group currently playing in the Gloucestershire league. Please do come and visit us at Dyson Perrins Sports Centre in Malvern on Thursdays from 8pm to 10pm.

fields.name: Ross Badminton Club
fields.blurb: We are a friendly club, playing in Ross on Wye.  We have teams in local leagues, and welcome new members who would like to play matches, or just want to enjoy some social badminton.

fields.name: Roxburgh Badminton Club
fields.blurb:
Roxburgh Badminton Club is a Gloucestershire league-playing club that plays on a Monday 8-10 pm at Stratford Park Leisure Club in Stroud, GL5. 

Membership fees for 2025/26 are £22 per month. We are actively looking to increase our women membership and would welcome women to come and try out for free.

fields.name: Severnside Badminton Club

Severnside is a strong league club suitable for players who want to regularly play technically and tactically competent league and club badminton.
Club nights are Mondays and Thursdays, home matches are Fridays.
